tools.name: x_amz_bedrock_agentcore_search
tools.description: A special tool that returns a trimmed down list of tools given a context. Use this tool only when there are many tools available and you want to get a subset that matches the provided context.

assetLid.description: Lukka Asset LID (e.g. LA7SQV7F4A4, LA6EV2NKQ95, LA8VRAGEMT1)

tools.name: refdata___get_asset_by_id
tools.description: Get full asset details by Lukka Asset LID (e.g. LA7SQV7F4A4 for ADA, LA6EV2NKQ95 for XBT). Returns all detail sections: asset, name, status, supply, blockchain, sector, participant, media, successor, underlying, collateral, stable, rebase, governance, tokenomics, valueProposition.

asOf.description: Coverage stats as of this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)

lukkaAssetIds.description: Comma-delimited list of Lukka Asset IDs to filter (e.g. LA6EV2NKQ95)

tools.name: refdata___get_asset_coverage_stats
tools.description: Asset coverage statistics from Lukka Reference Data - counts by blockchain, type, and status. Optionally filter by specific asset IDs or get historical coverage as of a given timestamp.

assetLid.description: Lukka Asset LID (e.g. LA6EV2NKQ95 for XBT, LA2EYFUQT32 for AAVE)

domain.description: Which domain's crypto actions to return. Supported values: assetMappings, pairMappings.

tools.name: refdata___get_asset_crypto_actions
tools.description: Crypto actions (LCA) for a specific asset by Lukka Asset LID. Returns event history including hard forks, airdrops, chain migrations, token swaps, and other material events for one asset. Requires domain param specifying the action domain (assets, derivatives, assetMappings, pairMappings). Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___get_asset_exposure
tools.description: Get crypto asset exposure classification data. Shows exposure level (direct/indirect), asset type, underlying assets, collateral, and value propositions for each asset. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

entityCode.description: Canonical Lukka entity code to filter by, for example KRAK (Kraken), CPRO (Coinbase Pro), BINA (Binance) or GMNI (Gemini). Use the canonical code, not the exchange's trade name.

mapProcessedEndTime.description: Filter by mapping processed end time (ISO 8601)

lukkaAssetCode.description: Filter by Lukka asset code (e.g. XBT)

mapEffectiveEndTime.description: Filter by mapping effective end time (ISO 8601)

mappingStatus.description: Filter by status: Active, Inactive, or all (default: all)

mapProcessedStartTime.description: Filter by mapping processed start time (ISO 8601)

entityAssetCode.description: Filter by entity asset code (e.g. BTC)

mapEffectiveStartTime.description: Filter by mapping effective start time (ISO 8601)

lukkaAssetId.description: Filter by Lukka Asset ID (e.g. LA6EV2NKQ95)

tools.name: refdata___get_asset_mappings
tools.description: Cross-reference asset mappings (LMAP) between Lukka standardized codes and entity-specific codes. Normalizes unstandardized naming across exchanges, custodians, wallets, and lending platforms. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___get_core_asset_scores
tools.description: Asset quality scores (LCAS). Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

lukkaCryptoActionParentId.description: Lukka UUID for grouping multiple crypto action events (e.g. 0cfe9ad8-34b9-4d5d-8f7a-6878f9a55f42)

lukkaCryptoActionId.description: Lukka UUID for a unique crypto action event (e.g. 21fb2a98-e551-4de2-816f-e84cf6e67e01)

lukkaCryptoActionCode.description: Lukka action code enum (e.g. CTMIG, HFORK)

effectiveTime.description: Returns actions with effectiveTime greater than this value (ISO 8601)

lukkaCryptoActionIds.description: Comma-delimited list of crypto action UUIDs (max 75)

tools.name: refdata___get_crypto_actions
tools.description: Lukka Crypto Actions (LCA) - comprehensive treatment methodology for 25+ crypto action event types tracking changes to asset structure and characteristics. Covers hard forks, airdrops, chain migrations, token swaps, and other material market events with structured metadata (what changed, when, why). Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___get_derivative_by_id
tools.description: Get full derivative contract details by Lukka Derivative LID (e.g. L-BINA-PERP-UNI-USD, L-DERI-OPT-BTC-BTC-C-43000-20210917). Returns all detail sections: derivativeDetails, settlementDetails, underlyingDetails, participantDetails, statusDetails.

code.description: Canonical Lukka entity code, for example CPRO (Coinbase Pro), KRAK (Kraken), BINA (Binance) or GMNI (Gemini). Use the canonical code, not the exchange's trade name.

tools.name: refdata___get_entity_by_code
tools.description: Get entity details by code (e.g. COINBASE, BINANCE)

enumName.description: Enum variable name. Values: lukkaCryptoActionCode, classificationCode, assetTypeCode, hashAlgorithmCode, consensusClassificationCode, emissionClassificationCode, emissionTypeCode, lukkaBlockchainId, tokenStandardCode, participantTypeCode

tools.name: refdata___get_enums
tools.description: Enumerated codes used across Lukka Reference Data APIs. Deciphers codes and static values for various endpoints. Returns enumCode + description pairs.

identifierTypeCode.description: Filter by identifier type code (e.g. LEI, SICIL)

tools.name: refdata___get_legal_entity_mappings
tools.description: Legal entity identifier mappings between Lukka legal entities and external identifier systems (e.g. LEI, SICIL). Maps lukkaLegalEntityId to identifierValue with processing/effective time tracking. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

marketId.description: Lukka market identifier. Format is LM followed by hexadecimal characters, for example LM7LWWLBC02. A plain integer is not a valid value.

tools.name: refdata___get_market_scores
tools.description: Market quality scores. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

entityCode.description: Filter by entity code (e.g. CBSE, BIUS)

lukkaPairCode.description: Filter by Lukka pair code (e.g. XBT-USD)

mapProcessedEndTime.description: Filter by mapping processed end time (ISO 8601)

entityAssetTwoCode.description: Filter by entity counter asset code (e.g. USD)

lukkaAssetOneCode.description: Filter by Lukka base asset code (e.g. XBT)

lukkaAssetTwoId.description: Filter by Lukka counter asset ID (e.g. LA3YM6GRUJ4)

mapEffectiveEndTime.description: Filter by mapping effective end time (ISO 8601)

entityPairCode.description: Filter by entity pair code (e.g. BTC/USD, BTCUSDC)

mappingStatus.description: Filter by status: Active, Inactive, or all (default: all)

lukkaAssetOneId.description: Filter by Lukka base asset ID (e.g. LA6EV2NKQ95)

lukkaPairMapId.description: Filter by specific pair mapping UUID

mapProcessedStartTime.description: Filter by mapping processed start time (ISO 8601)

entityAssetOneCode.description: Filter by entity base asset code (e.g. BTC)

mapEffectiveStartTime.description: Filter by mapping effective start time (ISO 8601)

lukkaAssetTwoInternalId.description: Filter by Lukka counter asset internal ID (e.g. 167)

tools.name: refdata___get_pair_mappings
tools.description: Cross-reference pair mappings (LMAP) between Lukka standardized pair codes and entity-specific pair codes. Normalizes trading pair naming across exchanges and platforms. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___get_reference_assets
tools.description: Reference asset data. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___get_reference_derivatives
tools.description: Reference derivative data. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___get_reference_pairs
tools.description: Reference trading pairs. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

assetLid.description: Filter by Asset Lukka ID (e.g. LA6PY42YA30, LA1S39UVDK1)

limit.description: Max results per page (default: 100, max: 1000, max 50 for detailed)

tools.name: refdata___get_sectors
tools.description: Lukka Digital Asset Classification Standard (LDACS) - 5-tier sector hierarchy for crypto assets. Tiers: Category (tier 1) → Super Sector (tier 2) → Macro Sector (tier 3) → Mid Sector (tier 4) → Sub Sector (tier 5). Each asset can have primary and secondary classifications with effective date ranges. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data (max 50 items).

lukkaAssetIds.description: Lukka Asset IDs as a bracketed comma-separated list. MUST be wrapped in square brackets. Example: [LA6EV2NKQ95,LA2EYFUQT32]. Single id: [LA6EV2NKQ95].

expandDetails.description: Expansion criteria for additional data. Options: [ALL], [statusDetails], [nameDetails], [assetDetails], [supplyDetails], [blockchainDetails], [sectorDetails], [participantDetails], [mediaDetails], [successorDetails], [underlyingDetails], [allowedCollateralDetails], [stableDetails], [rebaseDetails]. MUST pass the whole value wrapped in square brackets. Example: [ALL] or [nameDetails,blockchainDetails].

tools.name: refdata___list_assets
tools.description: List digital assets from Lukka Reference Data (LRD) - institutional-grade security master for crypto. Tracks 100+ fields including asset type, structure, participants, supply, underlying assets. Use expandDetails for rich data. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

expiresAfter.description: Filter derivatives expiring after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

entityCode.description: Filter by exchange entity code (e.g. DERI for Deribit)

expiresBefore.description: Filter derivatives expiring before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)

underlyingAssetCode.description: Filter by underlying asset code (e.g. XBT, ETH)

expandDetails.description: Expansion criteria for additional data. Options: [ALL], [derivativeDetails], [participantDetails], [settlementDetails], [statusDetails], [underlyingDetails]. Comma-separated, wrapped in one set of square brackets (e.g. [ALL]).

tools.name: refdata___list_derivatives
tools.description: List derivative contracts from Lukka Derivatives Data (LDRD) - institutional-grade security master for crypto derivatives. Tracks 50+ fields including type, settlement, participants, underlying assets, with standardized naming across venues. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___list_entities
tools.description: List all known entities in Lukka - exchanges, custodians, OTC desks, prime brokers, wallets, blockchains, and other entity types. Returns entityId, entityCode, entityName, entityType, entityUrl, entityStatus. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data.

tools.name: refdata___list_vasps
tools.description: List Virtual Asset Service Providers. Summary default, detailed=true for raw data. There is no entityCode filter on this endpoint; each returned row carries lukkaEntityCode, so filter client-side on that value to narrow to a specific exchange.
